data.title: 椎名真白 · 樱花庄画架下的素白晨梦
data.action: 毫无防备地赤足站在落地画架前，手里拿着画笔在空气中虚画，纯白长发凌乱披散在几近透明的睡衣上，赤眸单纯清澈如初生婴儿。
data.location: 樱花庄202号画室，满地散落的画布、油画颜料罐与未完成的年轮蛋糕包装
data.lighting: 清晨澄澈高亮度的纯白晨曦洒满画室，在透明的睡衣与白皙肌肤上泛起朦胧圣光
data.camera: front view, low angle, wide shot
data.mood: 天才艺术家的极致纯粹与毫无生活常识的天然纯美，不食人间烟火
data.description: 樱花庄202号画室，满地散落的画布、油画颜料罐与未完成的年轮蛋糕包装。毫无防备地赤足站在落地画架前，手里拿着画笔在空气中虚画，纯白长发凌乱披散在几近透明的睡衣上，赤眸单纯清澈如初生婴儿。 她微微抬眸轻语——“空太……今天想看什么颜色的画？……还有，帮我穿衣服。”
data.promptProse: Standing completely unguarded and barefoot before a tall wooden easel in her cluttered Sakura Hall art studio at dawn, Mashiro wears a featherweight semi-translucent white chiffon slip dress with fragile thin straps. Holding a paintbrush lightly aloft as though sketching in midair, she gazes down toward the viewer with calm, translucent innocence amidst scattered canvases and oil paint jars. Bright pale morning sunlight floods the room and turns the sheer white fabric softly luminous.
data.animaCaption: Standing barefoot beside her tall wooden easel in a sheer white spaghetti-strap chiffon slip dress, Mashiro holds a paintbrush midair and gazes calmly toward the viewer among scattered studio canvases. Bright dawn sunlight turns the translucent fabric luminous.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a featherweight pure white semi-translucent double-layer chiffon slip dress with ultra-thin straps, standing barefoot on the studio floor.
